```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Doctor
actor Chemist
actor Admin
participant "Patient History File" as PHF
participant "Consultation Request File" as CRF
participant "Appointment File" as AF
participant "Machine Learning Model" as ML
participant "Prescription File" as PF

== TC-001: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Appointment Mode) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms, Reports, Mode=Appointment, Date=Next Day)
CRF -> AF: Create Appointment Entry
AF -> CRF: Appointment Entry Created
CRF -> Patient: Consultation Request Created

== TC-002: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Offline Mode) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms, Reports, Mode=Offline)
CRF -> Patient: Consultation Request Created

== TC-003: Batch Program creates Appointment File for next 5 days ==
Admin -> AF: Run Batch Program
AF -> AF: Purge Existing Files
AF -> AF: Create Appointment Entries for Next 5 Days
AF -> Admin: Batch Program Completed

== TC-004: Machine Learning Model prioritizes Consultation Requests ==
ML -> CRF: Run Periodically
CRF -> ML: Fetch New Consultation Requests
ML -> ML: Predict Diseases and Prioritize Requests
ML -> CRF: Update Priorities
CRF -> ML: Priorities Updated

== TC-005: Doctor views and responds to prioritized Consultation Requests ==
Doctor -> CRF: View Prioritized Requests
CRF -> Doctor: Display Requests
Doctor -> CRF: Provide Diagnosis, Prescribe Medicines, Suggest Lab Requests
CRF -> Doctor: Request Updated

== TC-006: Chemist views and updates open prescriptions ==
Chemist -> PF: View Open Prescriptions
PF -> Chemist: Display Prescriptions
Chemist -> PF: Update Prescription Status
PF -> Chemist: Status Updated

== TC-007: Patient creates a Consultation Request with invalid date ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms, Reports, Mode=Appointment, Date=Not Next Day)
CRF -> Patient: Error: Date must be next day

== TC-008: Machine Learning Model handles boundary priority levels ==
ML -> CRF: Run Periodically
CRF -> ML: Fetch New Consultation Requests
ML -> ML: Predict Diseases and Prioritize Requests (Critical, Medium, Low)
ML -> CRF: Update Priorities
CRF -> ML: Priorities Updated

== TC-009: Verify Number of Consultations by Doctor (Month) ==
Doctor -> PHF: Request Consultation Count (Month)
PHF -> Doctor: Return Consultation Count (Month)

== TC-010: Verify Revenue Earned by Doctor (Month) ==
Doctor -> PHF: Request Revenue Earned (Month)
PHF -> Doctor: Return Revenue Earned (Month)

== TC-011: Verify Patient History File based on Patient Id ==
Patient -> PHF: Request Patient History (Patient Id)
PHF -> Patient: Return Patient History

@enduml
```
